content.short: Decent is crypto's payments layer uniting onchain experiences through seamless crosschain transactions.
content.description: Decent serves as a payments layer for crypto, designed to unify on‑chain experiences through smooth cross‑chain transactions. It provides a fiat‑to‑crypto onramp and a single‑click cross‑chain bridge at checkout, making it easier to move value across networks without leaving the checkout flow. The platform supports Ethereum, OP Mainnet, Arbitrum, Polygon, Multichain, BNB Chain, Avalanche, and Base, enabling a broad range of connected wallets and apps to transact across chains with ease.
content.meta: Decent is a crypto payments layer for seamless crosschain transactions. Discover Decent and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
